questions.question_text:
The classical free electron theory ________
(A) Explains the photoelectric behaviour assuming that electron moves in a constant potential
(B) Predicts the electron velocities based on Maxwell-Boltzmann law
(C) Was proposed by Arnold sommerfield
(D) Could not explain the concept of ferromagnetism
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: The classical Drude model (free electron theory) assumes electrons in a metal behave like a gas and follow Maxwell-Boltzmann statistics.

questions.question_text:
The ________ is a geometrical construction to the WS primitive cell in the k-space.
(A) Direct lattice
(B) Brillouin zone
(C) Real lattice
(D) Phonon zone
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: The first Brillouin zone is uniquely defined as the Wigner-Seitz primitive cell in the reciprocal lattice.

questions.question_text:
The Fermi level is ________
(A) An average value of all available energy levels
(B) An energy level at the top of the valence band
(C) The highest occupied energy level at 0 K
(D) The highest occupied energy level at 0 °C
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: By definition, the Fermi level (at T=0K) is the highest occupied energy level in a system of fermions.

questions.question_text:
In p-type semiconductor, numbers of holes are ________ the number of electrons.
(A) Greater than
(B) Equal to
(C) Less than
(D) Twice
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: In p-type semiconductors, holes are the majority carriers and electrons are the minority carriers.

questions.question_text:
Solar cell converts ________ energy into electrical energy.
(A) Sound
(B) Mechanical
(C) Light
(D) Magnetic
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: Solar cells use the photovoltaic effect to convert solar (light) energy directly into electrical energy.

questions.question_text:
A ________ is a quick determination method to identify whether a semiconductor sample is n (negative) type or p (positive) type.
(A) Electrolysis
(B) Hot point probe
(C) Hydrogenation
(D) Rectification
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: The Hot point probe is a simple, rapid technique used to determine the carrier type of a semiconductor.

questions.question_text:
The physical parameter that is probed in AFM resulting from different interactions is ________
(A) Charge
(B) Force
(C) Potential
(D) Current
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: AFM works by scanning a tip over a surface and measuring the mechanical forces (like Van der Waals) between the tip and the sample.
